guideFit.loopContinuity: Nearest-edge selection graph only; not a global topological guarantee or certified curve correspondence.

unguidedAlignment.loopContinuity: Nearest-edge selection graph only; not a global topological guarantee or certified curve correspondence.

limitations: Sampled surface/feature errors are not a Hausdorff certificate.
Topology and vertex links do not alone certify absence of all 3D self-intersections.
Binary geometric crease preservation does not imply arbitrary source attribute transfer.

scope: Actual Chromium Generate and OBJ download, independently reread output, unmodified reference validation, fresh unguided and changed-open-guide solves, rejected input and owned child cancellation.
